hypotheses.title: Winsorized Solvency Leverage and Deleveraging Cycle Duration Synergy
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Combines continuous winsorized balance sheet leverage (liabilities / assets, 90-day backfilled) with debt recapitalization cycle dynamics (ts_arg_min(debt / equity, 250)). Measuring the trading day distance to the 1-year minimum debt-to-equity ratio captures corporate capital structure inflection points and post-deleveraging equity rerating. 3-day linear decay dampens execution turnover to 2.91%, driving a Sharpe of 2.10 and Fitness of 1.86 with ultra-low self-correlation of 0.1726.
confounders: Rapid market-wide credit contraction impacting highly leveraged sectors
Debt restructuring through equity dilution rather than operational cash flow
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if high debt-to-equity minimum arrival distance leads to sustained equity underperformance across liquid large-caps.

candidates.rationale: Spectacular tier alpha with Sharpe 2.10, Fitness 1.86, Turnover 2.91%, Sub-universe Sharpe 1.10, and Self-Correlation 0.1726 (8/8 PASS).
